snippet.title: Minicar Shop Simulator  - announcement trailer & demo! #gameplay #games #steam
snippet.description:
MiniCar Shop Simulator - play the demon and wishlist on Steam.

Dive into MiniCar Shop Simulator! In this hi-octane retail sim you curate your dream miniature car store, unbox legendary finds in sealed boxes, zoom through deliveries on your scooter, showcase your collection, and conquer tiny racetracks! Become the ultimate tiny car tycoon!

More coming soon, from Super Duper Vibes.
